theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (δ : ℝ) (π : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen U → x ∈ U → x ∈ N → 0 < δ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 π (ball x δ) → MapsTo π (ball x δ) N → (∀ y ∈ N ∩ ball x δ, π y = y) → (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s ≤ δ ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball x s, ∀ z ∈ ball x s, ‖π y - π z‖ ≤ (1 + η) * ‖y - z‖) → ∀ lams : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 < lams j) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ G : ℝ, 0 < G → ∃ πs : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid P, (∀ᶠ j in atTop, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (πs j) (ball 0 G) ∧ MapsTo (πs j) (ball 0 G) (dilation x (lams j) '' (U ∩ N)) ∧ (∀ y ∈ dilation x (lams j) '' (U ∩ N) ∩ ball 0 G, πs j y = y) ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball 0 G, ‖πs j y‖ ≤ 2 * ‖y‖) ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ y ∈ ball 0 G, ∀ z ∈ ball 0 G, ‖πs j y - πs j z‖ ≤ (1 + η) * ‖y - z‖
